verdict.rationale: A public pricing page at fireflies.ai/pricing lists features such as AskFred, real-time notes, multi-language mode, meeting search, team analytics and audit logs, and the security page names Enterprise-only features like private storage. That suggests features are laid out by tier, but the pack never shows a free plan, actual prices, or which tier includes what. Missing for 10: evidence of a free tier, per-tier prices, an explicit tier-by-tier feature mapping, confirmation that basic plans are self-serve without contacting sales, and independent corroboration.
